text:
mike: quick thread- customer reported duplicate SSE events on reconnects, attaching short notes.

nina: what flow produced dups?

mike: client connected -> got e1,e2 -> connection stalled at edge proxy (no FIN) ~30s -> client reconnects with Last-Event-ID=e1 -> server resumes and also proxy flushed buffered bytes -> client saw e1 twice.

tara: sounds like proxy half-close detection + socket drain = duplicate. do we see proxy queued_bytes anywhere?

mike: nope, telemetry gap. console only has reconnect/resume counts, not per-conn queued bytes.

infra-bot: deploy-log: edge-proxy pool-2 rolled at 2026-03-21T08:00Z :white_check_mark:

nina: mitigation ideas: lower keepalive on the pool, enable TCP_USER_TIMEOUT, add queued_bytes gauge on proxy, and a console flag "possible-duplicate-on-reconnect" when queued_bytes > X.
tara: agree. prefer proxy metric + canary TTL change instead of server dedupe (clients expect inclusive resume).
mike: I'll open a tiny repro script & ping infra for a 2h canary keepalive=20s on pool-2. nina, can you own the console tile if we get the metric?
nina: yep, I can add a small dashboard tile + alert for queued_bytes > 32KB for >30s.

infra-bot: @infra-team scheduled canary request: pool-2 keepalive=20s at 2026-03-21T14:30Z. Rollback window 2h.
